overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Council properly entered executive session under Purpose 3 to discuss collective bargaining strategy with the firefighters' union, even though some terms had been agreed. The complaint was resolved.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council met in executive session on August 10, 2021 for an improper purpose, discussing a firefighters' union memorandum of agreement.
allegations.key_passage: We find that it was appropriate for the Council to meet in executive session under Purpose 3 where the Council discussed its strategy with respect to the collective bargaining agreement with the firefighters’ union.
